the inn's sleep jingle: the first 8.75s of "In the Arms of Althyk". The game's entry is CRI HCA (format 26), which nothing here encodes, so the replacement is written in whatever --audio-format names and the entry's format changes. No sheet references this path -- the bgm sheet holds only music/ -- so `match --discover` will not recreate this entry and a regeneration of presets/ drops it. Length is stated because the entry does not loop and the album track runs 11.01s: with nothing to truncate at, the render would take the whole recording.
